# Psalm 107 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Give-thanks to-YHWH for good, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**2** Let-say the-redeemed-of YHWH, whom he-has-redeemed from-hand-of the-adversary,

**3** And-from-the-lands he-has-gathered-them, from-east and-from-west, from-north and-from-south.

**4** They-wandered in-the-wilderness in-a-wasteland way; a-city-of habitation not they-found.

**5** Hungry also thirsty, their-soul in-them fainted.

**6** And-they-cried to-YHWH in-their-distress; from-their-troubles he-delivered-them.

**7** And-he-led-them by-a-way straight, to-go to-a-city-of habitation.

**8** Let-them-give-thanks to-YHWH for-his-steadfast-love, and-his-wonders to-sons-of man.

**9** For he-satisfied a-soul longing, and-a-soul hungry he-filled with-good.

**10** Dwellers-of darkness and-shadow-of-death, prisoners-of affliction and-iron,

**11** For they-rebelled-against words-of God, and-counsel-of the-Most-High they-spurned.

**12** And-he-humbled with-labor their-heart; they-stumbled and-there-was-no helper.

**13** And-they-cried to-YHWH in-their-distress; from-their-troubles he-saved-them.

**14** He-brought-them-out from-darkness and-shadow-of-death, and-their-bonds he-broke.

**15** Let-them-give-thanks to-YHWH for-his-steadfast-love, and-his-wonders to-sons-of man.

**16** For he-broke gates-of bronze, and-bars-of iron he-cut.

**17** Fools from-way-of their-transgression, and-from-their-iniquities they-were-afflicted.

**18** All food their-soul abhorred, and-they-drew-near to-gates-of death.

**19** And-they-cried to-YHWH in-their-distress; from-their-troubles he-saved-them.

**20** He-sent his-word and-healed-them, and-delivered from-their-pits.

**21** Let-them-give-thanks to-YHWH for-his-steadfast-love, and-his-wonders to-sons-of man.

**22** And-let-them-sacrifice sacrifices-of thanksgiving, and-let-them-recount his-deeds with-singing.

**23** Those-going-down to-the-sea in-ships, doing business on waters many,

**24** They have-seen the-works-of YHWH, and-his-wonders in-the-deep.

**25** And-he-spoke and-he-raised a-wind-of storm, and-it-lifted-up its-waves.

**26** They-went-up to-heavens, they-went-down to-depths; their-soul in-trouble melted.

**27** They-reeled and-staggered like-a-drunkard, and-all their-wisdom was-swallowed-up.

**28** And-they-cried to-YHWH in-their-distress, and-from-their-troubles he-brought-them-out.

**29** He-made-stand the-storm to-calm, and-were-hushed their-waves.

**30** And-they-were-glad because-they-were-quiet, and-he-guided-them to-harbor-of their-desire.

**31** Let-them-give-thanks to-YHWH for-his-steadfast-love, and-his-wonders to-sons-of man.

**32** And-let-them-exalt-him in-assembly-of the-people, and-in-seat-of the-elders let-them-praise-him.

**33** He-makes rivers a-wilderness, and-springs-of water a-thirsty-ground,

**34** A-land-of fruit a-salt-waste, because-of-wickedness-of those-dwelling in-it.

**35** He-makes a-wilderness a-pool-of water, and-a-dry-land springs-of water.

**36** And-he-settles there the-hungry, and-they-establish a-city-of habitation.

**37** And-they-sow fields and-plant vineyards, and-they-make fruit-of produce.

**38** And-he-blesses-them and-they-multiply greatly, and-their-cattle not he-diminishes.

**39** And-they-are-diminished and-bowed-down from-oppression-of evil and-sorrow.

**40** Pouring contempt on-princes, and-he-makes-them-wander in-waste without-way.

**41** And-he-sets-on-high the-needy from-affliction, and-he-makes like-a-flock families.

**42** See the-upright and-be-glad, and-all wickedness has-shut its-mouth.

**43** Who is-wise and-he-will-observe these-things? And-they-will-understand the-steadfast-love-of YHWH.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **107:8,15,21,31**: Fourfold refrain: 'Let-them-give-thanks to-YHWH for-his-steadfast-love' — the psalm's structural backbone, following four rescue scenarios.

- **107:20**: 'He-sent his-word and-healed-them' — the word itself is the agent of healing; divine speech as therapeutic power.

— EMET
